x: Jarvis, off 4 yards, in a closely contested final from Pemberton and Williams, two young sprinters, both under nineteen, who are rapidly improving.
Barker, 12 (10½ [?]), J S Williams, 6½ [?] (10 3-5); B J Fleming, 7 (10 7-10), V Pemberton, 10 (10 7-10); C.

Scrimshaw took the "half" and, running a brainy race with Gowar, sent Pemberton away with a nice lead. Powter then took over and, keeping well away from the Gaytonian, handed over to Tosh who, running strongly over the last 440yds. won by 40yds.
